_readme: Short audio meditations for the library (shown after the program). Put a link in 'url' once a recording is uploaded; until then the script is shown to read. Add or remove items freely; 'id' must be unique, lower case, no spaces.

meditations.title: A two-minute reset
meditations.summary: For when you need to come back to yourself, fast.
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: Wherever you are, let your shoulders drop. Breathe in slowly for four... and out for six. Again. Notice your feet on the ground. You're here, and you're okay right now.

meditations.title: Riding the wave
meditations.summary: Sit with an urge and watch it rise, peak and pass.
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: Notice where you feel the urge in your body. Don't fight it and don't follow it. Just watch it, like a wave coming in. It will build, and then it will break and roll back out.

meditations.title: Setting your intention
meditations.summary: Start the day knowing what matters to you.
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: Before the day gets going, bring your why to mind. Picture one moment today where you'd like to feel in control. What will you do in that moment?

meditations.title: Payday calm
meditations.summary: For the day the money lands.
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: Money in the account can stir things up. Take a breath. Remember the plan you made for today's pay: bills, savings, then the rest. You decide where it goes.

meditations.title: After a slip
meditations.summary: Be kind to yourself and get back on track.
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: A slip doesn't undo the work you've done. Breathe. Speak to yourself the way you'd speak to a mate in the same spot. What's one small step you can take right now?

meditations.title: Body scan
meditations.summary: Let go of tension from head to toe.
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: Start at the top of your head and slowly move your attention down. Notice any tightness, and breathe into it. Let each part of you soften as you go.

meditations.title: Winding down for sleep
meditations.summary: Settle a busy mind at the end of the day.
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: Lie back and let the day go. Each breath out, let a little more of the day go with it. There's nothing you need to do right now but rest.

meditations.title: Three good things
meditations.script: PLACEHOLDER: Think of three good things from today, however small. A cuppa, a laugh, a moment of quiet. Stay with each one for a breath or two.
